edgeCases.description: 1 to 3 edge-case variants of the recorded flow. Can be empty if none are useful.

nameSuffix.description: Short PascalCase-friendly phrase unique to this edge case, e.g. 'InvalidPassword'.

title.description: Human-readable scenario title, e.g. 'Login fails with an invalid password'.

rationale.description: One sentence: what this edge case tests and why it matters.

overrides.description: Only the steps that change from the happy path.

stepOrder.description: The Order of the step being overridden, matching the input flow's step list.

newInputValue.description: New value for a 'type' step. Null if this override is for an assertion step instead.

newExpectedText.description: New expected text for an 'assertText'/'assertVisible' step. Null if this override is for a type step instead.
